title: Transport of normalized evaluation tensor data
statement: For an essentially small ringed site and any object U as in [def-zl-condensed-lisse-evaluation-model], assume the small sectionwise derived category exists and evaluation at U has [lem-zl-contractible-derived-sections-tensor]. For every choice of finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation proofs for ordinary internal-module sections, the induced termwise derived functor (sections U).mapDerivedCategory has a strong monoidal structure for the fixed native derived tensor products. U need not be terminal. This is tensor transport only, with no realization or adjunction assertion.

proof.text: The internal-section tensor comparison gives natural invertible ordinary tensor and unit comparisons satisfying associativity and both unit laws. Package their inverses as the strong monoidal structure on the exact section-module equivalence.

Restrict the cochain-level exact monoidal equivalence to categorical K-flat complexes. Functorial flat resolutions identify the restricted localization with the derived category; monoidal equivalences preserve K-flat complexes. The localization tensorator is invertible on this subcategory. Apply monoidal functor descent to the canonical factorization of the exact derived functor. This works with the actual localization choices in the statement.

Apply the proved native-model identification to the coefficient tensor model contained in heval. Its tensor natural isomorphism, common localized unit and constraint equations give a strong monoidal identity functor from the native derived tensor to that model. Compose with the given monoidal evaluation datum.

Compose the two strong monoidal derived functors, and transport their structure through the exact derived composition isomorphism to the fixed termwise derived sections functor. Finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation witnesses are proofs, so this proves the conclusion for each pair appearing in the statement.

proof_origin.note: P9: ordinary tensor comparison, direct monoidal localization on K-flat complexes, and the existing native-model identification; no new unproved obligations.

theorem contractible_sections_monoidal
    {C : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) [(J.W (A := Ab.{u + 1})).IsMonoidal]
    (O : Sheaf J Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj O] [IsCommMonObj O]
    (U : C)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj (ringSheaf J O)))]
    (heval : ContractibleDerivedSectionsTensor.{u + 1, u, 0} J (ringSheaf J O) (op U)) :
    ∀ (hlim : PreservesFiniteLimits (sections J O U))
      (hfin : PreservesFiniteColimits (sections J O U)),
      letI := hlim
      letI := hfin
      Nonempty (sections J O U).mapDerivedCategory.Monoidal
